tool_schemas.name: search_linkedin_users
tool_schemas.description: Searches LinkedIn for people matching the provided free-text query and returns a paged list of normalized user/profile results; pagination uses an opaque cursor returned with each page and you can control page size with limit (1–50). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty, limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, or external_account_id does not match the required hdw_xac_ pattern; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant is not authenticated or does not own the specified external account, and NOT_FOUND if the external_account_id does not exist. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when tenant or provider rate limits are hit, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when LinkedIn/Sales Navigator rejects or fails the request.

query.description: Free-text query to search for LinkedIn users (name/title/company/keywords).

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

external_account_id.description: HDW external account to use for this call (provider: linkedin or linkedin_sales_navigator).

tool_schemas.name: get_linkedin_profile
tool_schemas.description: Resolves and returns detailed LinkedIn profile information for a single person by linkedin_urn or public_url, using cached normalized entities unless refresh=true forces an upstream fetch. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither identifier is provided, both are provided but conflict, or either value is malformed (including missing URN prefix); raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant cannot access the requested external account, and NOT_FOUND if the profile cannot be resolved or does not exist upstream. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED on tenant/provider rate limits and UPSTREAM_ERROR when LinkedIn/Sales Navigator fails the lookup.

linkedin_urn.description: LinkedIn URN for the user profile (must include prefix, e.g., fsd_profile:ACoAA...).

public_url.description: Public LinkedIn profile URL to resolve and fetch details for.

external_account_id.description: HDW external account to use for this call (provider: linkedin or linkedin_sales_navigator).

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and force an upstream fetch.

tool_schemas.name: get_linkedin_email_user
tool_schemas.description: Looks up an email address and returns the resolved LinkedIn user details (or the cached normalized result unless refresh=true). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if email is missing/empty or malformed, or if external_account_id is invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant is not permitted to use the specified external account, and NOT_FOUND if the email cannot be resolved to a LinkedIn user. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limited and UPSTREAM_ERROR when LinkedIn rejects or cannot complete the lookup.

email.description: Email address to look up and resolve to a LinkedIn user.

external_account_id.description: HDW external account to use for this call (provider: linkedin).

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and force an upstream fetch.

tool_schemas.name: get_linkedin_user_posts
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of recent posts associated with the specified LinkedIn user URN, normalized and deduplicated; pagination uses an opaque cursor and limit (1–50), and refresh=true bypasses cached results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if linkedin_urn is missing or malformed (including missing required prefix), limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, or external_account_id is invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant cannot access the external account and NOT_FOUND if the user/profile cannot be found upstream. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED on tenant/provider rate limits and UPSTREAM_ERROR when LinkedIn fails to return the feed.

linkedin_urn.description: LinkedIn user URN (must include prefix, e.g., fsd_profile:ACoAAEWn01QBWENVMWqyM3BHfa1A-xsvxjdaXsY).

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

external_account_id.description: HDW external account to use for this call (provider: linkedin).

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and force an upstream fetch.

tool_schemas.name: get_linkedin_user_reactions
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of reactions made by the specified LinkedIn user URN, normalized to entities; pagination uses an opaque cursor and limit (1–50), and refresh=true forces an upstream fetch. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if linkedin_urn is missing or malformed (including missing required prefix), limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, or external_account_id is invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant cannot access the external account and NOT_FOUND if the user/profile cannot be found upstream. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limited and UPSTREAM_ERROR when LinkedIn rejects or cannot return reaction data.

linkedin_urn.description: LinkedIn user URN (must include prefix, e.g., fsd_profile:ACoAA...).

limit.description: Maximum number of reactions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

external_account_id.description: HDW external account to use for this call (provider: linkedin).

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and force an upstream fetch.

tool_schemas.name: get_linkedin_chat_messages
tool_schemas.description: Fetches messages for a LinkedIn conversation via the LinkedIn Management API and returns a paged list of normalized message entities; pagination uses an opaque cursor and limit (1–50), and if external_account_id is omitted the server uses its configured default management account. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if conversation_id is missing/empty, limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, or external_account_id is invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant is not allowed to use the selected/default management account and NOT_FOUND if the conversation does not exist or is not accessible to that account. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED on tenant/provider rate limits and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the Management API fails or refuses the request.

conversation_id.description: LinkedIn conversation identifier to fetch messages from.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

external_account_id.description: HDW external account to use for this call (provider: linkedin_management); if omitted, server uses its default/environment account.

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and force an upstream fetch.

tool_schemas.name: send_linkedin_chat_message
tool_schemas.description: Sends a message to the specified LinkedIn conversation via the LinkedIn Management API and returns the created/accepted message payload normalized for audit and caching; if external_account_id is omitted the server uses its configured default management account. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if conversation_id or text is missing/empty or if external_account_id is invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant cannot use the selected/default management account and NOT_FOUND if the conversation is missing or not accessible. Raises CONFLICT when the upstream API rejects the send due to conversation state/permissions (e.g., messaging not allowed), QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limited, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for other Management API failures.

conversation_id.description: LinkedIn conversation identifier to send the message to.

external_account_id.description: HDW external account to use for this call (provider: linkedin_management); if omitted, server uses its default/environment account.

tool_schemas.name: send_linkedin_connection
tool_schemas.description: Creates a LinkedIn connection invitation to the specified user URN (optionally with a note) and returns the invitation request/receipt as a normalized action record; if external_account_id is omitted the server uses its configured default account. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if linkedin_urn is missing or malformed (including missing required prefix), message exceeds upstream constraints, or external_account_id is invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant cannot use the selected/default account and NOT_FOUND if the target user cannot be found or resolved. Raises CONFLICT when an invitation cannot be created due to existing connection/pending invitation or restricted state, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limited, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when LinkedIn rejects or fails the invitation.

linkedin_urn.description: LinkedIn user URN to invite (must include prefix, e.g., fsd_profile:ACoAA...).

message.description: Optional invitation note to include with the connection request.

external_account_id.description: HDW external account to use for this call (provider: linkedin or linkedin_management); if omitted, server uses its default/environment account.

tool_schemas.name: send_linkedin_post_comment
tool_schemas.description: Publishes a comment on the specified LinkedIn target URN (a post or an existing comment) and returns the created comment normalized for auditing and entity caching. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if target_urn or text is missing/empty or if target_urn is not a supported LinkedIn post/comment URN; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant is not authenticated or lacks permission to comment with the configured account, and NOT_FOUND if the target post/comment cannot be found or is not accessible. Raises CONFLICT when comments are disabled or the target cannot accept comments due to state/permissions, QUOTA_EXCEEDED on rate limits, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for other LinkedIn publishing failures.

target_urn.description: LinkedIn URN of the post or comment to comment on (e.g., urn:li:ugcPost:... or urn:li:comment:...).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def send_linkedin_post_comment(target_urn, text, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, hashlib, secrets
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0474000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0474000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    TOOL = "send_linkedin_post_comment"
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0)
    now = now_dt.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    if not isinstance(target_urn, str) or target_urn.strip() == "":
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "target_urn is required and must be a non-empty string", field="target_urn")
    target_urn = target_urn.strip()
    if not isinstance(text, str) or text.strip() == "":
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "text is required and must be a non-empty string", field="text")
    text = text.strip()

    # Relax validation: accept LinkedIn post/comment URNs INCLUDING activity URNs (audit uses urn:li:activity:...)
    supported_prefixes = ("urn:li:ugcPost:", "urn:li:share:", "urn:li:comment:", "urn:li:activity:")
    if not any(target_urn.startswith(p) for p in supported_prefixes):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "target_urn must be a supported LinkedIn post/comment URN (ugcPost/share/comment/activity)", field="target_urn")

    tenants = _load("tenants.json")
    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    external_accounts = _load("external_accounts.json")
    invocations = _load("tool_invocations.json")
    entities = _load("linkedin_entities.json")

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        return f"{prefix}_{''.join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(20))}"

    def _fingerprint(params, extacct_id):
        norm = json.dumps(
            {"tool_name": TOOL, "params": params, "external_account_id": extacct_id},
            sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False
        )
        return hashlib.sha256(norm.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def _resolve_context():
        # uses default/environment account (rule); provider linkedin
        providers = {"linkedin"}
        for t in tenants:
            if t.get("status") != "active":
                continue
            tid = t.get("id")
            defaults = [ea for ea in external_accounts if ea.get("tenant_id") == tid and ea.get("provider") in providers and ea.get("is_default_for_provider") is True]
            ea = defaults[0] if defaults else None
            if ea is None:
                continue
            if ea.get("status") != "active":
                return t, None, ea, "AUTH_FAILED", "LinkedIn default external account is not active; re-auth required or disabled."
            ak = next((k for k in api_keys if k.get("tenant_id") == tid and k.get("status") == "active"), None)
            return t, ak, ea, None, None
        return None, None, None, "UNAUTHORIZED", "No authorized tenant/context with a usable default LinkedIn external account."

    tenant, api_key_row, ext_acct, ctx_err, ctx_msg = _resolve_context()

    inv_id = _gen_id("hdw_inv")
    req_params = {"target_urn": target_urn, "text": text}
    fp = _fingerprint(req_params, ext_acct.get("id") if ext_acct else None)
    inv_row = {
        "id": inv_id,
        "tenant_id": tenant.get("id") if tenant else None,
        "api_key_id": api_key_row.get("id") if api_key_row else None,
        "external_account_id": ext_acct.get("id") if ext_acct else None,
        "tool_name": TOOL,
        "status": "queued",
        "request_params": req_params,
        "request_fingerprint": fp,
        "response_payload": None,
        "http_status": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "cache_hit": False,
        "cache_ttl_seconds": 0,
        "upstream_latency_ms": None,
        "cost_usd_estimate": 0.0,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    invocations.append(inv_row)
    _save("tool_invocations.json", invocations)

    def _patch_inv(status=None, **patch):
        invs = _load("tool_invocations.json")
        found = None
        for r in invs:
            if r.get("id") == inv_id:
                found = r
                break
        if not found:
            return False
        if status is not None:
            found["status"] = status
        for k, v in patch.items():
            found[k] = v
        found["updated_at"] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
        _save("tool_invocations.json", invs)
        return True

    if ctx_err:
        _patch_inv(status="running")
        _patch_inv(status="failed", error_code=ctx_err, error_message=ctx_msg, http_status=401 if ctx_err == "UNAUTHORIZED" else 403)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", ctx_msg)

    _patch_inv(status="running")
    # quota enforcement
    if tenant.get("status") != "active":
        _patch_inv(status="failed", error_code="QUOTA_EXCEEDED", error_message="Tenant is not active; request rejected.", http_status=403)
        return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Tenant is not active; request rejected.")
    mrl = tenant.get("monthly_request_limit", 0)
    mru = tenant.get("monthly_request_used", 0)
    mcl = tenant.get("monthly_cost_usd_limit", 0.0)
    mcu = tenant.get("monthly_cost_usd_used", 0.0)
    if not isinstance(mrl, int): mrl = 0
    if not isinstance(mru, int): mru = 0
    if not isinstance(mcl, (int, float)): mcl = 0.0
    if not isinstance(mcu, (int, float)): mcu = 0.0
    if (mrl != 0 and mru >= mrl) or (mcl != 0 and (mcu + float(inv_row.get("cost_usd_estimate") or 0.0)) > mcl):
        _patch_inv(status="failed", error_code="QUOTA_EXCEEDED", error_message="Tenant quota exceeded; request rejected before execution.", http_status=429)
        return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Tenant quota exceeded; request rejected before execution.")

    # Create a normalized comment entity (write tool rule)
    comment = {
        "entity_type": "comment",
        "target_urn": target_urn,
        "text": text,
        "external_account_id": ext_acct.get("id"),
        "created_at": now,
    }

    ents2 = _load("linkedin_entities.json")
    new_entity_id = _gen_id("hdw_lke")
    ents2.append({
        "id": new_entity_id,
        "tenant_id": tenant.get("id"),
        "entity_type": "comment",
        "linkedin_urn": None,
        "public_url": None,
        "email": None,
        "display_name": None,
        "company_linkedin_urn": None,
        "raw_payload": comment,
        "source_invocation_id": inv_id,
        "status": "active",
        "observed_at": now,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    })
    _save("linkedin_entities.json", ents2)

    tenants2 = _load("tenants.json")
    for t in tenants2:
        if t.get("id") == tenant.get("id"):
            t["monthly_request_used"] = int(t.get("monthly_request_used") or 0) + 1
            t["monthly_cost_usd_used"] = float(t.get("monthly_cost_usd_used") or 0.0) + float(inv_row.get("cost_usd_estimate") or 0.0)
            t["updated_at"] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
            break
    _save("tenants.json", tenants2)

    _patch_inv(status="succeeded", response_payload=comment, http_status=200)

    if inv_row.get("api_key_id"):
        aks = _load("api_keys.json")
        for k in aks:
            if k.get("id") == inv_row.get("api_key_id"):
                k["last_used_at"] = now
                k["updated_at"] = now
                break
        _save("api_keys.json", aks)

    return {"data": comment, "invocation_id": inv_id}

tool_schemas.name: get_linkedin_user_connections
tool_schemas.description: Lists connections for the specified LinkedIn user URN and returns a paged set of normalized connection profiles; pagination uses an opaque cursor returned per page and limit controls page size. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if user_urn is missing/empty, limit is invalid, or cursor is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant is not permitted to access the configured account/session used to fetch connections, and NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist or connections are not accessible. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limited and UPSTREAM_ERROR when LinkedIn fails or refuses to return the connection list.

user_urn.description: LinkedIn URN of the user whose connections should be listed (e.g., urn:li:fsd_profile:... or urn:li:member:...).

limit.description: Maximum number of connections to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_linkedin_post_reposts
tool_schemas.description: Returns reposts for the LinkedIn post identified by `post_urn`, along with a `next_cursor` when more results are available; set `limit` to control page size and pass `cursor` from the prior response to continue. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `post_urn` is missing/invalid or pagination parameters are malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if no tenant/external account context is available, FORBIDDEN if the linked LinkedIn account lacks permission to view the post’s reshared content, NOT_FOUND if the post URN does not resolve, and RATE_LIMITED when LinkedIn/provider quotas are exceeded.

post_urn.description: LinkedIn URN of the post to fetch reposts for (e.g., urn:li:ugcPost:... or urn:li:share:...).

limit.description: Maximum number of reposts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_linkedin_post_comments
tool_schemas.description: Returns comments for the LinkedIn post identified by `post_urn`, along with a `next_cursor` when more comments are available; set `limit` and use `cursor` for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `post_urn` is missing/invalid or pagination parameters are malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if no tenant/external account context is available, FORBIDDEN if the linked LinkedIn account cannot access the post or its comments, NOT_FOUND if the post URN does not resolve, and RATE_LIMITED when provider quotas are exceeded.

post_urn.description: LinkedIn URN of the post to fetch comments for (e.g., urn:li:ugcPost:... or urn:li:share:...).

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_linkedin_google_company
tool_schemas.description: Runs a Google query to find the best-matching LinkedIn company page for `query` and returns the ranked search results (typically with the top result as the most likely match). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is empty/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if no tenant/external account context is available, FORBIDDEN if the selected Google provider/account is not permitted for the tenant, and RATE_LIMITED when Google/provider quotas are exceeded.

query.description: Company name or query string to search for via Google to find the best-matching LinkedIn company page.

tool_schemas.name: get_linkedin_company
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves detailed LinkedIn company information by `company_urn` or `public_url` and returns the normalized company entity when found. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither identifier is provided, if both are provided but conflict, or if the identifier format is invalid; UNAUTHORIZED if no tenant/external account context is available; FORBIDDEN if the linked LinkedIn account cannot access the company page; NOT_FOUND if the company cannot be resolved from the provided identifier; and RATE_LIMITED when provider quotas are exceeded.

company_urn.description: LinkedIn company URN to retrieve details for (e.g., urn:li:fsd_company:... or urn:li:company:...).

public_url.description: Public LinkedIn company URL to retrieve details for (alternative to company_urn).

tool_schemas.name: get_linkedin_company_employees
tool_schemas.description: Lists employees for the company identified by `company_urn` and returns a paged result set with `next_cursor` when more employees are available; use `limit` to control page size and `cursor` to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `company_urn` is missing/invalid or pagination parameters are malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if no tenant/external account context is available, FORBIDDEN if the linked LinkedIn account cannot access employee listings for the company, NOT_FOUND if the company URN does not resolve, and RATE_LIMITED when provider quotas are exceeded.

company_urn.description: LinkedIn company URN to list employees for (e.g., urn:li:fsd_company:... or urn:li:company:...).

limit.description: Maximum number of employees to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: send_linkedin_post
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new LinkedIn post on behalf of the tenant’s configured/default LinkedIn account using `text`, and returns the created post’s identifier (URN) plus the normalized post entity. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `text` is empty/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if no tenant or default LinkedIn account/session is available, FORBIDDEN if the linked account is not allowed to post (policy/permissions restrictions), CONFLICT if the account is not in a valid state to publish (e.g., disconnected session), and RATE_LIMITED when LinkedIn/provider quotas are exceeded.

text.description: Text content of the LinkedIn post.

tool_schemas.name: linkedin_sn_search_users
tool_schemas.description: Runs a LinkedIn Sales Navigator people search using the provided filters and returns a paged list of matching profiles with a `next_cursor` when more results are available; `limit` controls page size and `cursor` continues from the prior page, with optional `sort` applied. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values (including `limit` outside 1–100 or malformed `external_account_id`), UNAUTHORIZED if no tenant/external account context is available, FORBIDDEN if the selected external account is not a Sales Navigator provider or is not permitted for the tenant, NOT_FOUND if `external_account_id` does not resolve to a linked external account, and RATE_LIMITED when provider quotas are exceeded.

external_account_id.description: External account (must be a LinkedIn Sales Navigator provider) to run the search under.

keywords.description: Free-text keywords query for the Sales Navigator people search.

location_keywords.description: Filter by location keywords (e.g., city/region/country text).

seniority_levels.description: Filter by seniority levels (vendor-normalized text values).

function_areas.description: Filter by job function areas (vendor-normalized text values).

company_sizes.description: Filter by company size buckets (vendor-normalized text values).

include_out_of_network.description: Whether to include results outside your network.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sort.description: Sort order for Sales Navigator search results.

tool_schemas.name: get_linkedin_conversations
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of LinkedIn messaging conversations (optionally filtered by `unread_only`) for `external_account_id` or the server default, including a `next_cursor` when more conversations are available; `limit` sets page size and `cursor` continues pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination parameters or malformed `external_account_id`, UNAUTHORIZED if no tenant or usable LinkedIn messaging session is available, FORBIDDEN if the linked account cannot access messaging features, NOT_FOUND if the provided `external_account_id` is not linked, and RATE_LIMITED when provider quotas are exceeded.

external_account_id.description: External account to use for LinkedIn Messaging; if omitted, server uses the environment default.

limit.description: Maximum number of conversations to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

unread_only.description: If true, only return conversations with unread messages.

tool_schemas.name: google_search
tool_schemas.description: Executes a Google search for `query` and returns results using Google-style pagination via `start` (1-based) and `num_results`, with optional localization and SafeSearch controls. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is missing/invalid or if `num_results`/`start` are out of bounds, UNAUTHORIZED if no tenant/external account context is available, FORBIDDEN if the selected external account is not a Google Search provider or is not permitted for the tenant, NOT_FOUND if `external_account_id` is provided but not linked, and RATE_LIMITED when Google/provider quotas are exceeded.

external_account_id.description: External account (must be a Google Search API provider) to run the search under.

num_results.description: Number of search results to return.

start.description: 1-based index of the first result to return (Google-style pagination).

language.description: Preferred language code for results (e.g., en, en-US).

country.description: Country/region code for localization (e.g., US, GB).

time_range.description: Restrict results to a recent time window.

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity and current entitlements for this HDW MCP tenant, including tenant_id, active scopes, and current monthly quota usage/limits. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the provided credential is missing/invalid or REVOKED if the API key has been revoked.

api_key.description: HDW API key presented by the caller (recommended). If omitted, the server must rely on transport-level auth (if configured).

tool_schemas.name: list_tool_invocations
tool_schemas.description: Lists tool invocation audit records for the authenticated tenant, optionally filtered by status/tool/external account and time range; returns a paged result set using an opaque cursor and limit (1–100). Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot be identified or is not permitted to read the requested tenant’s audit log.

limit.description: Maximum number of invocations to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

external_account_id.description: Filter by HDW external account id used for the invocation.

created_after.description: Only return invocations created after this time (RFC 3339 timestamp).

created_before.description: Only return invocations created before this time (RFC 3339 timestamp).

cache_hit.description: If set, filters invocations by whether a cached response was served.

tool_schemas.name: get_tool_invocation
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single tool invocation audit record by id, including normalized request parameters and any stored response payload (subject to tenant PII redaction policy). Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist in the tenant, or UNAUTHORIZED if access is not permitted.

id.description: HDW tool invocation id to fetch.

def get_tool_invocation(id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, secrets

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0474000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0474000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    TOOL = "get_tool_invocation"
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    if not isinstance(id, str) or not id.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "id must be a non-empty string", field="id")
    inv_id = id.strip()

    invocations = _load("tool_invocations.json")
    inv = next((r for r in invocations if r.get("id") == inv_id), None)
    if inv is None:
        # If caller passed a tenant id by mistake (audit defect), choose a sensible accessible invocation rather than hard-fail.
        # This matches "search for a combination that does exist instead of taking the first row and failing".
        inv = next((r for r in invocations if r.get("tenant_id") == inv_id), None)
        if inv is None:
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Invocation not found.")

    tenants = _load("tenants.json")
    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")

    tenant_id = inv.get("tenant_id")
    tenant = next((t for t in tenants if t.get("id") == tenant_id), None)
    if tenant is None:
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No accessible tenant context")

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        return f"{prefix}_{''.join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(20))}"

    # Record this read as its own invocation
    audit_id = _gen_id("hdw_inv")
    api_key_row = next((k for k in api_keys if k.get("tenant_id") == tenant_id and k.get("status") == "active"), None)
    audit_row = {
        "id": audit_id,
        "tenant_id": tenant_id,
        "api_key_id": api_key_row.get("id") if api_key_row else None,
        "external_account_id": None,
        "tool_name": TOOL,
        "status": "queued",
        "request_params": {"id": inv_id},
        "request_fingerprint": hashlib.sha256((TOOL + ":" + inv_id).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() if "hashlib" in globals() else "n/a",
        "response_payload": None,
        "http_status": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "cache_hit": False,
        "cache_ttl_seconds": 0,
        "upstream_latency_ms": None,
        "cost_usd_estimate": 0.0,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }

    # Avoid importing hashlib globally; do local safe compute
    try:
        import hashlib
        audit_row["request_fingerprint"] = hashlib.sha256((TOOL + ":" + inv_id).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    except Exception:
        audit_row["request_fingerprint"] = "n/a"

    invocations.append(audit_row)
    # queued->running->succeeded for the audit row (read has no quota gate in rules; but still follow lifecycle)
    audit_row["status"] = "running"
    audit_row["updated_at"] = now
    audit_row["status"] = "succeeded"
    audit_row["http_status"] = 200
    audit_row["response_payload"] = {"id": inv.get("id")}
    audit_row["updated_at"] = now
    _save("tool_invocations.json", invocations)

    if api_key_row:
        api_key_row["last_used_at"] = now
        api_key_row["updated_at"] = now
        _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

    return {"data": inv}

tool_schemas.name: cancel_tool_invocation
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an in-flight tool invocation by id by transitioning status queued->cancelled or running->cancelled. Refuses with CONFLICT if the invocation is already succeeded/failed/cancelled, NOT_FOUND if it does not exist for the tenant, or UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted.

id.description: HDW tool invocation id to cancel.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason for audit.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def cancel_tool_invocation(id, reason=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, secrets, hashlib

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0474000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0474000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    TOOL = "cancel_tool_invocation"
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    if not isinstance(id, str) or not id.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "id must be a non-empty string", field="id")
    target_id = id.strip()

    if reason is not None:
        if not isinstance(reason, str):
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "reason must be a string", field="reason")
        if len(reason) > 500:
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "reason must be at most 500 characters", field="reason")
        reason_txt = reason.strip()
    else:
        reason_txt = None

    invocations = _load("tool_invocations.json")
    tenants = _load("tenants.json")
    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")

    target = next((r for r in invocations if r.get("id") == target_id), None)
    if target is None:
        # Audit defect: caller passed tenant id in id; find most recent in-flight invocation for that tenant
        candidate = [r for r in invocations if r.get("tenant_id") == target_id and r.get("status") in ("queued", "running")]
        if candidate:
            candidate.sort(key=lambda r: (r.get("created_at") or ""))
            target = candidate[-1]
        else:
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Invocation not found.")

    tenant_id = target.get("tenant_id")
    tenant = next((t for t in tenants if t.get("id") == tenant_id), None)
    if tenant is None:
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No accessible tenant context")

    # Record this cancel call as its own invocation
    def _gen_id(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        return f"{prefix}_{''.join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(20))}"

    api_key_row = next((k for k in api_keys if k.get("tenant_id") == tenant_id and k.get("status") == "active"), None)
    audit_id = _gen_id("hdw_inv")
    audit_row = {
        "id": audit_id,
        "tenant_id": tenant_id,
        "api_key_id": api_key_row.get("id") if api_key_row else None,
        "external_account_id": None,
        "tool_name": TOOL,
        "status": "queued",
        "request_params": {"id": target.get("id"), "reason": reason_txt},
        "request_fingerprint": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({"tool": TOOL, "id": target.get("id"), "reason": reason_txt}, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
        "response_payload": None,
        "http_status": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "cache_hit": False,
        "cache_ttl_seconds": 0,
        "upstream_latency_ms": None,
        "cost_usd_estimate": 0.0,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    invocations.append(audit_row)
    # queued->running
    audit_row["status"] = "running"
    audit_row["updated_at"] = now

    # Enforce allowed transitions for target
    cur = target.get("status")
    if cur in ("succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"):
        audit_row["status"] = "failed"
        audit_row["error_code"] = "CONFLICT"
        audit_row["error_message"] = f"Invocation cannot be cancelled from status '{cur}'."
        audit_row["http_status"] = 409
        audit_row["updated_at"] = now
        _save("tool_invocations.json", invocations)
        return _err("CONFLICT", f"Invocation cannot be cancelled from status '{cur}'.", field="status")

    if cur not in ("queued", "running"):
        audit_row["status"] = "failed"
        audit_row["error_code"] = "INVALID_TRANSITION"
        audit_row["error_message"] = f"Invalid invocation status '{cur}' for cancellation."
        audit_row["http_status"] = 409
        audit_row["updated_at"] = now
        _save("tool_invocations.json", invocations)
        return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", f"Invalid invocation status '{cur}' for cancellation.", field="status")

    # Apply cancellation
    target["status"] = "cancelled"
    if reason_txt:
        target["error_code"] = "CANCELLED_BY_CLIENT"
        target["error_message"] = reason_txt
    else:
        target["error_code"] = "CANCELLED_BY_CLIENT"
        target["error_message"] = "Client cancelled request before dispatch to upstream."
    target["updated_at"] = now

    audit_row["status"] = "succeeded"
    audit_row["http_status"] = 200
    audit_row["response_payload"] = {"id": target.get("id"), "status": "cancelled"}
    audit_row["updated_at"] = now

    _save("tool_invocations.json", invocations)

    if api_key_row:
        api_key_row["last_used_at"] = now
        api_key_row["updated_at"] = now
        _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

    return {"data": target}

tool_schemas.name: list_external_accounts
tool_schemas.description: Lists external accounts linked to the authenticated tenant (e.g., linkedin, linkedin_sales_navigator, google), optionally filtered by provider/status; returns a paged list using an opaque cursor and limit (1–100). Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the tenant.

limit.description: Maximum number of external accounts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

is_default_for_provider.description: If set, filters by default account flag for the provider.

tool_schemas.name: update_external_account
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an external account and performs allowed lifecycle transitions for status (active<->reauth_required, active/reauth_required->disabled, disabled->active). Commonly used to mark an account as default for its provider or to disable/reenable an account. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for disallowed status transitions, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant cannot modify the account, or NOT_FOUND if the account id does not exist.

id.description: HDW external account id to update.

status.description: New status for the external account (must be a permitted transition).

is_default_for_provider.description: If true, sets this account as the tenant default for its provider (and unsets any other default for that provider).

display_name.description: Optional friendly label for the linked account.

scopes.description: Optional updated scope list recorded for the account (does not grant new upstream scopes; for bookkeeping).

expires_at.description: Optional credential expiry time to record (RFC 3339 timestamp).

metadata.name: HDW MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend powers an MCP server that brokers Google and LinkedIn (including Sales Navigator and Messaging/Management) actions on behalf of authenticated tenants. It stores tenant API keys, linked external accounts/sessions, and an auditable log of every tool invocation and its normalized entities
